meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户询问某条 senpi 提示(Tip)的含义时,Claude 会先查该用户实际可见的提示列表,再看代码,然后用用户的语言深入解释其原理并引用文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户提到某条 Tip: 行、说“give-me-tips”,或询问任何提示的含义时触发。

say.text: 这条 Tip: 行是什么意思?
say.note: 会先查你实际能看到的提示列表再解释。
会检查你的设置和可见范围。

say.text: 这个提示背后的功能是怎么实现的?
say.note: 会阅读代码并给出有文件出处的解释。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about any senpi tip, Claude first queries the live tip list, checks which tips that user can actually see, reads the relevant code, then explains the tip's real mechanism in the user's language, citing concrete file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions a Tip: line, says "give-me-tips", or asks about a tip's meaning.

say_en.text: What does this Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Queries the live tip list first.

say_en.text: give-me-tips, which tips can I see?
How does the feature behind this tip actually work?
say_en.note: Verifies against the real code and cites paths.
